title: The Tune at the Gate  (门口的曲调)

segments.t: 汉娜和阿瑟、伊芙琳一起匆匆赶到敞开的庭院大门前，热情地招呼那位站在街上倾听的老邻居。先完整听一遍吧。
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段充满惊喜的重逢。
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
'打扰一下，先生，您想进来喝杯热茶吗？'
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
'等等……我们十号小提琴店的邻居？！'
You know each other, Arthur?!
'你们认识彼此，阿瑟？！'
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
'三十年前，他每个星期五六点都带着他的小提琴来这里！'
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
'等等，看看我们那张旧明信片：“给面包师和老师留两把椅子”！'
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
'他就是那位和你阿姨在星期五合奏的音乐老师！'
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
'他刚才问我，是谁最终完成了她的五月华尔兹的下半部分！'
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
'阿瑟，他隔着窗户听到我弹的十六小节时说了什么？'
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
'他眼里含着泪水。他说听起来就像她的声音一样！'
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
'你邀请他参加我们这周五六点钟的盛大开业了吗？！'
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
'他答应带着他的小提琴，以及街那头的十个邻居一起来！'
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
'额外十个邻居？！到周五泰莎需要的柠檬得是现在的两倍了！'
接下来，让我们按自然语速再完整听一遍整场戏。

Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!

Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
那位三十年前星期五二重奏的搭档听到了敞开的窗户里传出的琴声，这周五六点，他不仅要带着他的小提琴来，还要带半条街的人来！第五集到这里就结束了——我们第二季大结局见！
Have a great evening!
